name: voice-shopping-assistant
description: Voice-driven shopping list manager with hybrid NLP and explainable suggestions

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vsa/shared && npm run build -w @vsa/api && npm run build -w @vsa/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @vsa/api" "npm run dev -w @vsa/web"
